premise: A ring of mushrooms pops up in the grass, and Pinecone and Ladybug turn it into a dance floor; each shows her big move, and Mushroom's is a glittery sneeze.
inspiration: The folk ring dance (the fairy ring), without the fairies: friends make their own magic in the circle.
lesson: Everyone can join the dance in their own way.

en-US.title: The Mushroom Ring Dance
en-US.text: One morning, a ring of little mushrooms popped up in the grass, round as a plate. And right in the middle popped up {mushroom:enter} Mushroom. [curious] What's it for? asked {pinecone:enter} Pinecone, rolling up. {mushroom:face happy} It looks like a dance floor! said Mushroom. Along walked {ladybug:enter} Ladybug. {ladybug:face happy} {pinecone:face happy} [excited] Then let's dance! {sfx:drum} Pinecone {pinecone:spin} rolled round the ring: roll, roll, roll. Ladybug {ladybug:hop x3} hopped from cap to cap: hop, hop, hop. Mushroom {mushroom:wobble x2} wiggled right where she was. [giggles] Now, everyone's big move! {pinecone:live} Pinecone opened her scales out wide like a twirly skirt… and closed them snug. {ladybug:live} Ladybug lifted her red wing cases, spread her thin wings, folded them away… and bowed. And Mushroom? {mushroom:live} She scrunched up her face… ah… ah… {sfx:sneeze} ACHOO! A puff of glitter sparkled over the ring. {all:face happy} [laughs] Everyone {all:wobble} tumbled down laughing. Again? said Mushroom. {mushroom:hearts} AGAIN! said everyone.

es-ES.title: El baile del corro de setas
es-ES.text: Una mañana brotó en la hierba un corro de setas pequeñitas, redondo como un plato. Y justo en el centro brotó {mushroom:enter} Seta. [curious] ¿Para qué es?, preguntó {pinecone:enter} Piña, que llegaba rodando. {mushroom:face happy} ¡Parece una pista de baile!, dijo Seta. Y llegó andando {ladybug:enter} Mariquita. {ladybug:face happy} {pinecone:face happy} [excited] ¡Pues a bailar! {sfx:drum} Piña {pinecone:spin} rodó alrededor del corro: rueda, rueda, rueda. Mariquita {ladybug:hop x3} saltó de sombrero en sombrero: salta, salta, salta. Seta {mushroom:wobble x2} se meneó sin moverse de su sitio. [giggles] ¡Ahora, el gran paso de cada una! {pinecone:live} Piña abrió sus escamas como una falda de vuelo… y las cerró bien juntitas. {ladybug:live} Mariquita levantó su caparazón rojo, desplegó sus alas finitas, las guardó… e hizo una reverencia. ¿Y Seta? {mushroom:live} Arrugó la cara… aaa… aaa… {sfx:sneeze} ¡ACHÍS! Un soplo de purpurina brilló sobre el corro. {all:face happy} [laughs] Todas {all:wobble} cayeron rodando de risa. ¿Otra vez?, dijo Seta. {mushroom:hearts} ¡OTRA VEZ!, dijeron todas.

drum.prompt: a light playful rhythm tapped on a hollow log, like a tiny forest drum

sneeze.prompt: a tiny, cute, high-pitched sneeze with a soft sparkly puff
